definition: A Pair names the same two individuals across alternatives. reframe a b u v applies a*x1+u to the first and b*x2+v to the second, with a,b strictly positive. Both alternatives use identical parameters. Each person's own order is preserved; the cross-person relative unit may change. AllPrefer uses the existing total, mean and critical arithmetic on the two-entry lists; c is fixed across alternatives. Invariance under this class is an explicit proposed adequacy standard, not a proved requirement of morality. A calibrated interpersonal scale may legitimately reject independent changes of unit. Fixed identity and count are essential; variable-population origin/critical-level effects are outside this theorem.
